summary: Institutional positioning is heavily focused on long-term volatility hedging and massive structural bets on the SPX, characterized by massive, balanced accumulation of deep-in-the-money/out-of-the-money LEAPS. The dominant pattern is a massive "strangle" build-up in SPX, specifically the 7000C and 8000P strikes extending into 2026 and 2027, suggesting institutions are pricing in extreme long-term expansion and contraction. Persistent interest is clearly visible in the SPX 7000C and 8000P (exp 2026-12-18), which have seen billions in accumulation over the last four sessions. Traders should watch for high-volatility regime shifts in the broader market, as the massive $17.4B SPX premium and heavy NVDA/MU put buying (P/C > 1.3) suggest a buildup of tail-risk protection despite the bullish SPX call flow.
